## Desired player-visible result

Describe the change and why it matters.

## Current behavior / reproduction

Include mod version, Minecraft/Forge version, relevant configuration, logs and screenshots when applicable.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Requested behavior works.
- [ ] Existing faction, inventory, persistence and cleanup rules remain intact.
- [ ] Relevant regressions and full Build pass; any untested in-game behavior is disclosed.

## Scope and constraints

List related systems, compatibility requirements and what is outside this task.

## Release expectation

Gameplay release / development PR only / documentation or tooling only.
Follow CONTRIBUTING.md for the tested-artifact release handoff.
